stories.headline: Royals' Lane Thomas: Clubs 10th homer in win
stories.detail: Thomas went 1-for-4 with a solo home run and a walk in Sunday's 5-4 win over the Tigers.

stories.headline: Royals' Michael Massey: Belts pinch-hit homer Sunday
stories.detail: Massey went 1-for-2 with a two-run home run in Sunday's 5-4 win over Detroit.

stories.headline: Athletics' Jeff McNeil: Stays hot in Sunday's loss
stories.detail: McNeil went 2-for-4 with two RBI and a run scored in Sunday's 11-8 loss to the Twins.

stories.headline: Yankees' Ben Rice: Belts 31st homer in loss
stories.detail: Rice went 2-for-5 with a solo homer, a double and an additional run scored in Sunday's 11-4 loss to the Phillies.

stories.headline: Phillies' Alec Bohm: Plates four runs in win
stories.detail: Bohm went 1-for-4 with a double, four RBI, two runs scored and a hit-by-pitch in Sunday's 11-4 win over the Yankees.

stories.headline: Phillies' Bryson Stott: Big offensive performance Sunday
stories.detail: Stott went 3-for-4 with a solo homer, a double and five total RBI in Sunday's 11-4 win over the Yankees.

stories.headline: Yankees' Will Warren: Tagged for six runs in fifth loss
stories.detail: Warren (7-5) took the loss Sunday, allowing six runs on six hits and two walks over three-plus innings against the Phillies. He struck out five.

stories.headline: Phillies' Cristopher Sanchez: Picks up 13th win
stories.detail: Sanchez (13-4) earned the win Sunday, allowing three runs on six hits and three walks over six innings against the Yankees. He struck out six.

stories.headline: Angels' Jorge Soler: Launches 12th long ball
stories.detail: Soler went 1-for-4 with a solo home run and an additional RBI in Sunday's 4-3 victory over the Giants.

stories.headline: Angels' Jo Adell: Smashes 16th homer
stories.detail: Adell went 1-for-4 with a two-run home run in Sunday's win over the Giants.

stories.headline: Secures first career save
stories.detail: Farris picked up the save Sunday against the Giants. He allowed no earned runs on a hit and no walks while striking out one over two-thirds of an inning.

stories.headline: Provides pinch-hit homer Sunday
stories.detail: Semien went 1-for-1 with a pinch-hit three-run home run in Sunday's 8-3 win over the Dodgers.

stories.headline: Designated for assignment
stories.detail: Hartlieb was designated for assignment by the Athletics on Sunday, Jason Burke of Roundtable.io reports.

stories.headline: Hurt by homers in first loss
stories.detail: Whisenhunt (2-1) took the loss Sunday, allowing four runs on five hits and two walks over five innings against the Angels. He struck out seven.

stories.headline: Earns ninth win
stories.detail: Soriano (9-6) earned the win Sunday, allowing one unearned run on three hits and three walks over five innings in a 4-3 win over San Francisco. He struck out five.

stories.headline: Cracks 11th homer in loss
stories.detail: Duran went 1-for-3 with a solo home run and an additional RBI in Sunday's 6-4 loss to the Mariners.

stories.headline: Slaps three-run homer
stories.detail: Taylor went 1-for-3 with a three-run home run and a hit-by-pitch in Sunday's 8-3 win over the Dodgers.

stories.headline: Homers in three-hit performance
stories.detail: Arozarena went 3-for-5 with a solo home run in Sunday's 6-4 win over the Rangers.

stories.headline: Goes yard in three-hit effort
stories.detail: Canzone went 3-for-5 with a three-run homer, a double and an additional RBI in Sunday's 6-4 win over the Rangers.

stories.headline: Dominant in 18th save
stories.detail: Munoz picked up the save in Sunday's 6-4 win over the Rangers. He struck out three across a perfect inning.

stories.headline: Allows one run in no-decision
stories.detail: DeGrom did not factor into the decision Sunday, allowing one run on seven hits and no walks over five-plus innings against Seattle. He struck out four.

stories.headline: Goes deep during loss
stories.detail: Stowers went 2-for-4 with a solo home run and a double in Sunday's 5-3 loss to the Padres.

stories.headline: Nears quality start Sunday
stories.detail: Gilbert did not factor into the decision Sunday, allowing three runs on five hits and two walks over 5.2 innings in a 6-4 win over the Rangers. He struck out four.

stories.headline: Completes four-inning rehab start
stories.detail: Jobe (elbow) struck out four and allowed one earned run on two hits and two walks across four innings in a rehab start Saturday with Double-A Erie.
